name: Winterbite

frame.name: Big Frigid Glaive
frame.description: Fires a large ball of energy that locks onto nearby targets and freezes them. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.

perks.name: Supercooled Accelerator
perks.description:
Optimized for extended range.
  •  Increases range
  •  Slightly decreases reload speed
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Alloy Magazine
perks.description: Faster reload when the magazine is nearly empty.

perks.name: Weighted Edge
perks.description: This weapon's melee attacks deal increased damage and slow targets when loaded with ammo.

perks.name: Tilting at Windmills
perks.description: Blocking damage with your shield increases movement speed while shielding.

flavor: Don't slip or you'll hurt yourself. A lot.

catalyst.name: Winterbite Catalyst
catalyst.description: Destroying a Stasis crystal or defeating a frozen target with this weapon grants you Frost Armor.
